summary: Defines version 3 of the Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) for IPv4 and IPv6. VRRP elects which router on a LAN is responsible for a virtual router, so another can take over if it fails. It obsoletes RFC 5798, which obsoleted RFC 3768.

eli5.summary: If the main teacher is absent, a substitute steps in so class continues. VRRP lets backup routers take over when the main one fails.
